cases.claim: The proposed tool addresses the lack of real-time tools for beginner developers to check form accessibility.
cases.evidence: Beginner developers report difficulty identifying keyboard navigation and screen-reader labeling problems. The guide describes testing form labels and validation messages.

cases.claim: Existing healthcare tools focus purely on individual datasets and lack cohesive synthesis capabilities.
cases.evidence: Analysts report difficulty comparing service patterns using aggregate public data. The dataset contains de-identified aggregate wait-time and service-volume fields for educational analysis.

cases.claim: Proposed differentiation to test: a guided form-label checklist for beginners. Whether this is better than existing tools is unknown.
cases.evidence: Beginner developers report difficulty identifying keyboard navigation and screen-reader labeling problems.

cases.claim: The captured comparison found that tool A lacks keyboard-navigation checks.
cases.evidence: In this comparison, tool A checked contrast but did not provide keyboard-navigation checks. Tool B included both.

cases.claim: crop images labeled with leaf disease categories
cases.evidence: The public benchmark contains labeled crop images and permits non-commercial research. The label categories are not specified.
